summary.en: An automated repository governance system for open-source maintainers, turning issue proposals, PR review, branch cleanup, context handoff, external tasks, and release evidence into an auditable maintenance pipeline.

summary.en: A financial research application built on a general Data Agent and MoAgent Framework, connecting natural-language questions, real data, durable workers, generated workspaces, and quality gates in one traceable delivery pipeline.
